decisions: Minutes of the May 21, 2025 board meeting approved without amendments.
Engage a third-party collections specialist for accounts outstanding beyond 90 days, with a budget cap of $15,000 for FY2025.
Revise standard client payment terms from Net-45 to Net-30 for all new contracts signed on or after July 1, 2025.
Pierre Dubois to present a revised cash flow forecast at the July board meeting.
Aiyana Park to schedule a strategic discovery meeting with Acme Corp COO James Teller by July 15, 2025.
Draft and submit an expanded services proposal to Acme Corp (supply chain advisory and ESG compliance consulting) by August 8, 2025.
Pierre Dubois to assess staffing financial implications for the potential Acme Corp scope expansion and report by July 9, 2025.
Margaret Holvan to send a personal introductory correspondence to Acme Corp COO James Teller by June 25, 2025.
Initiate a formal RFP process for an integrated CRM and project management platform, to be completed by August 31, 2025.
Aiyana Park to present a shortlist of three IT platform vendors at the September board meeting.
Provisionally earmark a capital budget of up to $180,000 for the IT infrastructure upgrade in FY2025–2026.
Authorize a retained executive search partnership with Keller & Vance Recruiting, fee cap of $40,000 for FY2025.
Approve a 7% annual retention bonus program for employees with 3+ years of tenure, effective October 1, 2025, at approximately $95,000 per year.
Prioritize hiring for the ESG Practice Lead role with a target start date of September 1, 2025.
Aiyana Park to coordinate planning for the September 12, 2025 client appreciation event.
Place the firm's 20th anniversary initiative on the July 2025 board agenda.
Next board meeting confirmed for July 16, 2025 at 9:00 AM.
